name: manual_bcd29b
claim: Separate a short approval-receipt TTL from the execution-authority TTL: begin each authority window only in the durable dispatch-authorization transaction, never at first provider output.

decisions.notes: Provider acceptance and billing can precede observable output; a durable dispatch boundary prevents ambiguous starts from extending or reusing authority.

rationale: Provider acceptance and billing can precede observable output; a durable dispatch boundary prevents ambiguous starts from extending or reusing authority.
